text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, the final day.

That night, the Umamusume each enjoyed a 
brief moment of rest at the barbecue—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rob Ro~~~y! Are you eating a lot~!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!? T-Taiki-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, more, more, seconds! How about 
it!? I'll go get some!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: N-No, no, I've already had plenty...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Taiki-san is amazing, isn't she? Even 
though it's the final day of summer 
training camp and so many girls are 
completely exhausted—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you just grilling a bunch of food 
for everyone else by the fire until a 
moment ago? And it looked like you went 
out to buy groceries too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Because I love, very-very love BBQs! 
Leave everything to me♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm still doing A-OK! My power is 
plen-ti... plen-tiful... plentifully 
overflowing☆

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Was it... "I've got more than 
enough"...?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still... I see. Well, it's Taiki-san, 
after all. She's always so lively and full 
of power...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm-? ...Rob Roy? Hey, what is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Taiki-san. If it's okay with you, 
that is..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"After this... could I trouble you for a 
moment of your time?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ――What？

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Taken completely by surprise, Taiki-san 
blinked her gorgeous, wide blue eyes, 
bright as the midsummer sea.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I must have startled them. —Even so, even 
if they think I'm strange, I felt I had to 
speak right this moment.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Consecutive victories in the Mile CS and 
Sprinters S. And then the following spring 
at the Yasuda Kinen, pushing through a 
brutal, mud-soaked struggle to seize 
victory—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Winning the French GⅠ, the Prix Jacques 
Le Marois. And on top of that, winning her 
triumphant return race, the Mile CS...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(—As a sprinter/miler Umamusume, she 
became the first in history to be crowned 
"Umamusume of the Year".)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Together with her, who overturned all 
common sense and public opinion with sheer 
power.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...I simply felt that, right now, I 
wanted to talk.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... um... Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! What is it, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san... um, what kind of things were 
you thinking about when you took on the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The first sprint/mile Umamusume in history 
to be named 'Horse of the Year'...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"During the battles leading up to claiming 
that title... what kind of things did 
you..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fantastic＆Exciting！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So, well~... "Overwhelming"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking that very thing, YES! If 
you truly wish to blaze a new trail 
through the uncharted wilds, no matter how 
steep!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone loves fantastic! Everyone loves 
exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When faced with something "overwhelming," 
everyone's heart goes doki-doki! All eyes 
will be on them!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—That is why I thought it had to be that 
way!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Most Fantastic! Most Exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Because,I'm No.1!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If I am not... overwhelming...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm-... Hey, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ah, y-yes?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Life is what you make it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Rob Roy will be just fine!! I 
truly believe that!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Taiki-san—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (――Overwhelming.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I have to be overwhelming. To gain 
anything. To overturn everything.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I have to be overwhelming.)
